mechanisms.name: Representation floors
mechanisms.mechanism: Project the physical defect onto scalar, band, origin-channel and quadratic+cubic spans.
mechanisms.controls: Matched backbone/node/operator/cutoff; normalized GL2; bounded and unbounded oracle.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Channel/cubic floor falls below bounded scalar floor beyond reference uncertainty.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Error ratio, effective rank, conditioning, sensitivity, RMS/max/mean residual.
mechanisms.advance_if: New span resolves material scalar residual at useful conditioning.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Scalar floor already negligible, added columns redundant, or gain unresolved.
mechanisms.scope: Reference-informed fits only; squared L2 optimum does not optimize peak composite loss.
mechanisms.novelty: New-to-TDN experiment; literature priority not established
mechanisms.cost: All actual references, fitting, features, transports, products, warm/cold timing, failures and reporting retained; immutable unit ceilings in protocol.

mechanisms.name: Conditioner information
mechanisms.mechanism: Feature-matched states with varied phases and scale arrangements require incompatible acceptable response sets.
mechanisms.controls: Shared versus separately optimized gains; original/rich/spectral/phase features; full-field branch fixed.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Additional information reduces a resolved shared-response penalty.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Acceptable gain intervals, feature mismatch, shared excess error and feature cost.
mechanisms.advance_if: Interval ambiguity exceeds numerical/reference sensitivity and costs can plausibly repay.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Flat gain objectives or no excess error: do not enlarge the conditioner.
mechanisms.scope: Different futures alone do not prove conditioner insufficiency.
mechanisms.novelty: New-to-TDN experiment; literature priority not established
mechanisms.cost: All actual references, fitting, features, transports, products, warm/cold timing, failures and reporting retained; immutable unit ceilings in protocol.

mechanisms.name: Grid step duration cost
mechanisms.mechanism: Targeted N, h and T slices distinguish spatial floors from time-integration and overhead.
mechanisms.controls: Same continuous parent and fixed bandwidth; changed-bandwidth slice labeled; shared 1/2/4/8 menus.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: A workload region has reproducible accuracy-qualified cost headroom.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Endpoint/trajectory RMS/max, observed order, latency/memory and complete solve time.
mechanisms.advance_if: Freeze an informative region for independent evaluation.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Spatial error or overhead consumes the practical margin.
mechanisms.scope: Discrete and continuum targets remain separate; refinement can extend beyond eight steps.
mechanisms.novelty: New-to-TDN experiment; literature priority not established

mechanisms.name: Signed interactions
mechanisms.mechanism: Retained low modes depend on signed complex products of input modes.
mechanisms.controls: Pre-input versus output-only compression; normalized rule; scalar/band/channel models; local-path FNO.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Origin channels exploit phase/scale response that output bands alone cannot express.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Signed coefficient absolute and phase error with near-zero floor.
mechanisms.advance_if: Mechanism survives matched capacity/compression and credible neural controls.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Norm-only gain vanishes in signed coefficients or needs unavailable input.
mechanisms.scope: FNO local paths retain information; do not assume complete high-frequency loss.
mechanisms.novelty: New-to-TDN experiment; literature priority not established
mechanisms.cost: All actual references, fitting, features, transports, products, warm/cold timing, failures and reporting retained; immutable unit ceilings in protocol.

mechanisms.name: Interaction order
mechanisms.mechanism: Even/odd epsilon responses separate quadratic quadrature error from cubic spatial shape.
mechanisms.controls: GL2/GL4/refined same quadratic rule; matched quadratic+cubic; positive/negative perturbations.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Residual after refined quadrature has a resolved cubic direction beyond scalar rescaling.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Amplitude and h slopes separately; parallel/orthogonal cubic residual; quadrature contrast.
mechanisms.advance_if: Higher-order shape dominates; investigate a cheaper justified direction.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: More nodes or higher-order work fails its numerical/cost discrimination.
mechanisms.scope: Fit slopes only above reference uncertainty and roundoff.
mechanisms.novelty: New-to-TDN experiment; literature priority not established

mechanisms.name: Transient and autonomous fidelity
mechanisms.mechanism: Repeated own-output application can amplify or hide local errors.
mechanisms.controls: Teacher-forced tests separate; early dense reference times; unequal steps and beyond-training horizons.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Accurate trajectories remain stable beyond endpoint fitting.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Worst/integrated error, mean/variance/modes, thresholds, ranges and failure fraction.
mechanisms.advance_if: Stable accurate behavior with resolved transient advantage.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Stable but inaccurate or unstable behavior; revise or retire branch.
mechanisms.scope: Logistic mean is not conserved; endpoint equilibrium is insufficient.

mechanisms.name: Finite rough-surface benchmark
mechanisms.mechanism: Increasing represented fine scales changes nonlinear interactions and their lifetime.
mechanisms.controls: Fixed-bandwidth paired grids; added-scale slices; structured/random matched power; ridge and independent 2D.

mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Dimension label alone explains nothing or clipping/control mismatch confounds the comparison.

mechanisms.name: Pre-work cubic selection
mechanisms.mechanism: Use h*r*RMS(v) to decide whether to form cubic work.
mechanisms.controls: Always quadratic and always quadratic+cubic complete solves.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: Skipping cubic on easy fields preserves useful accuracy and saves complete time.
mechanisms.primary_metric: At least 1.10x complete speed, at most 5% RMS regression, at least 1.10x RMS accuracy gain over quadratic-only and no new maximum-target failures.
mechanisms.advance_if: All local utility criteria attained on held-out parents, then fresh pilot.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Phase blindness or selection overhead defeats savings.
mechanisms.scope: Deterministic adaptivity is established; selection must precede expensive work.

mechanisms.name: Signed cubic modulation
mechanisms.mechanism: Fit bounded gamma*P[v*Q(v)] as a cheaper signed cubic direction.
mechanisms.controls: Global LS fit on independent analytic-cubic fit parents; exact quadratic+cubic held-out control.
mechanisms.falsifiable_prediction: One signed product approximates useful cubic shape without nested transports.
mechanisms.primary_metric: Cubic-direction error, at least 1.10x RMS accuracy gain over quadratic-only, complete PDE RMS/max and at least 1.10x complete speed.
mechanisms.advance_if: At most 10% RMS regression, no new max-target failure and complete speed threshold.
mechanisms.stop_or_change_if: Shape mismatch persists or physical/transient behavior regresses.
mechanisms.scope: New-to-TDN diagnostic proposal; no literature novelty claim.
